summary: This bill, named the "Charlie Kirk Act," clarifies that materials prepared by the United States Agency for Global Media (USAGM) for dissemination abroad generally cannot be distributed within the U.S., with an exception allowing the Archivist of the United States to make such materials available domestically 12 years after their initial foreign release or creation.
